description: This file contains unit tests for ADO.NET streaming functionality in Orleans, specifically testing streaming against different databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It defines test classes, setup configurations, and multiple test methods for various streaming scenarios.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamingTests
